title: EnhancedClient
description: EnhancedClient is an optimization modpack that also add QOL Features
body:
EnhancedClient is a modpack aimed at improving performance and adding quality of life features. In order to improve the player experience.

---

 Features:
1. Shaders Support
2. No Chat Reporting
3. Better Performance
4. Controller Support
